Lina M.: FYI — proposing a short-lived rotation for SIEM export credentials + KMS unwrap windows to reduce blast radius. TL;DR: rotate export tokens every 7 days, enforce JIT KMS unwrap (1h per approval), and tighten RBAC on who can request unmask. See ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1234 :lock:

Jamal (oncall): +1. What's the rollback if export consumers break during rotation?

Trevor - eng-sre: We need a compatibility window and a migration plan. Suggest a 3-step rollout: 1) dual-accept old+new tokens for 14d, 2) start rejecting old tokens but log rejects for another 7d, 3) enforce expiry. Also need a healthcheck for export consumers. I'll sketch infra changes.

Mike Infra: We can implement token middleware in the export proxy to do a seamless check/upgrade: `export-proxy --validate-token --fetch-unwrapped-kms`. Also we should add a staging test harness that replays exported payloads against consumer mocks.

Anna (Legal): Legal: any change to retention windows is a non-starter without sign-off. Confirm this only affects access creds, not retention TTLs. Also we need an audit trail for regulators (ticket id + approver).

Lina M.: Correct — retention TTL stays as-is. Rotation is access-only. Plan excerpt: - token TTL: 7d - dual-accept window: 14d - JIT KMS unwrap window: 1h per approval - RBAC: only role `analyst:siem_export` and `soc:incident` can request unmask (via request flow). Example rotate command for staging service account key (AWS example):

```bash
# create new CMK alias and rotate unwrap key (staging)
aws kms create-key --description "siem-export-unwrap-staging"
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/siem-unwrap-staging --target-key-id $(aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[0].KeyId' --output text)
# rotate service account key used by export-proxy
aws iam create-access-key --user-name siem-export-proxy-staging
```

Trevor - eng-sre: Need an emergency bypass for SOC during incidents. Proposal: a temporary `soc-bypass` role that is auto-revoked after 4h and writes a tamper-evident audit entry. Must be gated by two approvers (oncall + security lead).

Jamal (oncall): Can we add rate limits and anomaly detection on unwrap events? :eyes: If someone does many unwraps in a short span, trigger a pager.

Mike Infra: Yep — unwrap events will be logged to the secure audit bucket (SSE-KMS), fields: timestamp, requester, role, key-id, request-id, reason (if provided). We'll ship a CloudWatch alert rule: `unwrap_count > 5 in 10m` for high-risk keys.

Anna (Legal): Also require ticket id AND approver username in the unwrap payload to satisfy auditors. If SOC uses `soc-bypass`, still require after-action ticket with justification.

deploy-bot: Runbook created: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/rotations/siem-export-rotation — includes test checklist, rollback steps, and required approvers.

Lina M.: I'll update RFC and push changes to SEC-1234 today. Next actions: Trevor will open infra PR for proxy middleware, Mike will add unwrap logging + alerts, Anna will draft the regulator note, Jamal will validate oncall runbook. I'll post diffs here when ready. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
